Powerful Performance in a Simple Package.

Dependable, No-Frills Workhorse for Every Job.

The 2024 KIOTI DK5520MB is a versatile and rugged utility tractor ideal for everything from property maintenance and farming to commercial landscaping. Featuring a 55 HP KIOTI diesel engine and 8×8 manual shuttle transmission, this ROPS model is designed for operators who prefer straightforward, mechanical reliability without sacrificing performance.

Whether you’re handling loader work, running implements, or maintaining acreage, the DK5520MB offers the power and simplicity to get the job done efficiently.

Features may include:

Fuel-Efficient Diesel Power
55 HP KIOTI 3-cylinder, water-cooled diesel engine delivers high torque, excellent fuel economy, and dependable performance.

8×8 Manual Shuttle Transmission
Smooth mechanical transmission with shuttle shift lets you change direction easily—perfect for loader operations.

Heavy-Duty 3-Point Hitch
Category I/II hitch with 3,177 lbs of lift capacity at hitch point handles a wide range of implements.

Rear PTO with Standard Controls
540 RPM rear PTO operates everything from cutters to tillers with dependable output.

Open ROPS Platform
Simple, spacious operator area with foldable ROPS for safety and visibility.

Power Steering
Standard power steering makes maneuvering easy, even under heavy loads.

Durable Axles and Chassis
Rugged build designed for long hours and hard work in demanding conditions.
